A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human">In its depiction of Imperial society, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' makes it clear that only [[Human/Legends|Human]] families could be considered nobility, as they and [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith purebloods]] were the only [[Species/Legends|species]] considered "pure." Additionally, almost all Sith purebloods were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], with non-Force-sensitives like [[Krannus]] an extreme rarity, and all Force-sensitives were trained as Sith in the Empire. Therefore, both the Sith and the noble are Humans.</ref> [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sith Lord''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was well-respected during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When a [[Unidentified Imperial noble (Sith relative)|nobleman]] related to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] fell out of favor, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] arranged for the man to be quietly escorted into exile.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Tough Love}}</ref>
